text.p: These are the main stories on the Angolan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The United Nations special envoy to Angola Alioune Blendin Beye said after talks with Angolan president Jose Eduardo dos Santos that no progress had been registered in Angola's peace process in two months. Beye is due to meet UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi on Thursday.
- Namibia's prime minister Hage Geingob, on a three-day visit to the capital Luanda, met his Angolan counterpart Fernando Franca Van Dumen on cooperation in fishing, tourism, trade, energy and water.
